experiment: FP32 Hessian accumulation-order null experiment (FR s0 / FC s0, layers 1/8/16/23)
question: Can changing only the FP32 accumulation order of the same expert Hessian contributions produce different GPTQ solutions and measurable model-level PPL variation?
mechanism: per-sequence contribution Xf.T @ Xf (FP32 GEMM, unchanged) added with FP32 += into the block of the sequence's ORIGINAL replay position (K=4 contiguous blocks of 32); blocks summed over dim 0; intervention permutes the replay order, keeping every sequence's block, so only the FP32 addition order inside each block changes

integrity_protocol.name: precision-aware installation integrity (actorder ablation); supersedes nothing: the frozen tolerance check of earlier studies is unchanged and still computed and reported for every configuration
integrity_protocol.I1: every one of the 720 installed BF16 projection tensors is bitwise equal to bfloat16(W_solver) of the FP32 solver output written back by E3 (checked at write-back for all 240 experts)
integrity_protocol.I2: for the 8 prespecified check experts (layers 1/8/16/23 x experts 0/30) the installed module's BF16 output on the frozen validation inputs is bitwise equal to an independent BF16 reference built from bfloat16(W_solver) with F.linear in the module's operation order (gate, up, act, mul, down)
integrity_protocol.I3: elementwise |W_bf16 - W_solver| <= 2^-8 |W_solver| (correct round-to-nearest; zeros stay zero) for all 720 tensors
integrity_protocol.I4: installed weights and checked outputs are finite
integrity_protocol.not_a_criterion: the relative FP32-vs-BF16 output deviation; it is reported (decomposed into weight representation and arithmetic) but never gates, because it measures the BF16 execution environment rather than installation correctness

decision_rule.tau_PPL: 1e-4 x BF16 PPL = 0.000923709 (operational materiality threshold, not a significance test)
precedence: RUN-BLOCKED: any correctness requirement fails - baseline (original-order) regression (Hessians 480/480 == frozen OO, natural act-order == P_O, weights / reconstruction / PPL / per-window NLL == frozen OO), routing == R_O for every token, identical per-(expert, block) contributing sequences and token counts across orders, bitwise-identical per-sequence contributions of the diagnostic experts across orders, non-finite Hessians, any required quantized configuration missing or invalid (240 experts, 720 tensors, 0 RTN fallbacks, permutation == P_O 240/240, Hessians == preflight 480/480, integrity I1-I4, repeat evaluation identical), or the deterministic repeatability control differs
NULL-ORDER-INVARIANT: all 10 shuffled-order Hessian sets (480 Hessians each) are bitwise identical to the original-order Hessians (no GPTQ is run)
ORDER-SENSITIVE-HESSIAN-ONLY: some Hessian differs, but the installed effective weights of all 10 configurations are bitwise identical to OO
ORDER-SENSITIVE-WEIGHTS-ONLY: effective weights differ in at least one configuration, and max over the 10 configurations of |PPL - PPL_OO| <= tau_PPL
ORDER-SENSITIVE-PPL: effective weights differ and at least one |PPL - PPL_OO| > tau_PPL
decision_rule.reported_not_gating: strategies affected, paired Delta change (|Delta_g - Delta_OO| > tau_PPL), FR/FC sign reversals, SDs vs the earlier AA / AO / AOF spreads (context only, never pooled)
decision_rule.repeatability_config: the first configuration in the prespecified order (FR then FC; seeds ascending) whose Hessians differ from the original-order Hessians is quantized twice in fresh processes
decision_rule.frozen: fixed before any shuffled-order GPTQ / PPL; never adjusted after outcomes

hard_constraints: no change of selections, caches, routing, act-order, group membership, GPTQ hyperparameters, precision, installation, evaluation; FP64 only as a diagnostic; no adaptive orders; earlier results untouched
